name: codex-react-ui
description: A local-first Codex workbench with a desktop Electron shell.
author: codex-ultra maintainers

scripts.build: bun --filter @codex-ui/shared build && bun --filter @codex-ui/server build && bun --filter @codex-ui/web build && node scripts/verify-production-artifacts.mjs apps/server/dist apps/web/dist
scripts.desktop:build:node: bun --filter @codex-ui/shared build && bun --filter @codex-ui/server build && bun --filter @codex-ui/web build:node
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run desktop:rebuild:pty && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --installer
scripts.desktop:package:portable: npm run desktop:rebuild:pty && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --portable
scripts.desktop:package:portable:armored: npm run desktop:rebuild:pty && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --portable --armor
scripts.desktop:package:windows: npm run desktop:rebuild:pty && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --all
scripts.desktop:package:windows:armored: npm run desktop:rebuild:pty && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --all --armor
scripts.package:windows: npm run lint && npm run desktop:build:node && npm run desktop:package:windows
scripts.package:portable: npm run lint && npm run desktop:build:node && npm run desktop:package:portable
scripts.verify:production-artifacts: node scripts/verify-production-artifacts.mjs apps/server/dist apps/web/dist desktop-dist artifacts/remote-node
scripts.desktop:compress:web: node scripts/compress-web-assets.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/verify-production-artifacts.mjs --verify-compressed apps/web/dist
scripts.package:windows:hardened: npm run lint && npm run desktop:build:node && npm run desktop:obfuscate && npm run desktop:compress:web && npm run desktop:obfuscate:server && npm run desktop:package:windows:armored
scripts.package:portable:hardened: npm run lint && npm run desktop:build:node && npm run desktop:obfuscate && npm run desktop:compress:web && npm run desktop:obfuscate:server && npm run desktop:package:portable:armored
